en: A black-and-white image showing a partially ruined medieval church with pointed-arch windows, a steeply gabled roof, and a tall, narrow spire with a cross on top. The church's upper portion appears more intact, while the lower parts of the structure show significant damage, likely from war or age. A small fence surrounds the church, and a lone dog is visible in the bottom left.
